references.text: The same command to count the Israelites by their clans and families, but there it applied to men twenty years old and upward who could go to war
The execution of the census of the Levites, where the number of all men from one month old and upward was recorded
Summary of the census of the Levites, all men from one month old and upward, totaling 22,000
A later count of the Levites, here also including all men from one month old and upward
The genealogy of Levi's sons and their families that forms the basis for the division of the Levites
The age limit for those to be counted and pay a ransom, from twenty years old and upward, in contrast to the Levites who were counted from one month old
The redemption price for the firstborn was to be paid from one month old, the same age limit as for counting the Levites
